goals_sound_first.label: Laid-back pocket
goals_sound_first.description: Backbeat and time feel slightly behind the beat; relaxed but confident.

suggested_knobs.reason: Optional subtle lilt depending on style

goals_sound_first.label: Tight + punchy
goals_sound_first.description: Cleaner timing, fewer small deviations, strong backbeat clarity.

goals_sound_first.label: More ghost notes
goals_sound_first.description: Adds lighter snare notes between backbeats for groove depth.

goals_sound_first.label: Less busy / more space
goals_sound_first.description: Fewer notes, clearer groove. Especially useful under vocals.

goals_sound_first.label: More energy / bigger chorus
goals_sound_first.description: More intensity and contrast in chorus (often more cymbal + harder hits).

suggested_knobs.reason: More ride in chorus when applicable

goals_technique_first.label: Ghost notes
goals_technique_first.description: Low-velocity snare notes that create internal subdivision feel.

goals_technique_first.label: Tom-led groove
goals_technique_first.description: Toms participate in the timekeeping/ostinato, not just fills.
goals_technique_first.notes: May require dedicated generator controls/presets beyond current defaults; start by using song/flavor presets that increase tom usage.

suggested_knobs.reason: More tom movement can arrive via fills initially

goals_technique_first.label: Ride timekeeping
goals_technique_first.description: Use ride as primary timekeeper (often choruses or jazz/rock).

preset_tier_guidance.song: Signature song-inspired intent (big, recognizable feel or orchestration bias).
preset_tier_guidance.flavor: Style color and vibe (ghost density, hat/ride preference, humanization).
preset_tier_guidance.utility: Practical helpers (tighten timing, reduce fills, simplify hats).
